name: 04_config_quoted_values
why: Humans quote values, and `.env.example` files ship quoted. A loader that keeps the quotes sends `"anhur_..."` as the X-API-Key header: every request 401s while the plugin still exits 0. One symmetric pair of quotes (single or double) must be stripped, and quotes INSIDE the value must survive.
on_failure: A fingerprint other than the expected one means that loader kept the quotes (or the surrounding spaces). Symptom in production: HTTP 401 on every write, memory silently empty.
